title: Joint posterior recovery with measurable state-dependent RGO parameters
source_anchor: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Algorithm3.3 parameter update and Theorem6.5 conditional recursive stages
target_statement: For a measurable state space S, fixed probability base mu on finite real Hilbert Borel E, measurable b:S->R,u:S->E,a:S->R with b>=0 and a>0 everywhere, construct Markov kernels T,H:S->E and B:S times E->S times E. Prove every T(s) is the normalized quadratic mu tilt at precision b(s), center u(s); H(s) is its actual Gaussian smoothing with variance a(s); B(s,y) retains s and samples the actual backward tilt, equivalently the original mu tilt with precision b(s)+1/a(s) and center (b(s)u(s)+y/a(s))/(b(s)+1/a(s)). For every probability state law lambda prove B composed with lambda compProd H equals lambda compProd T. Derive jointly measurable positive finite normalization and variable noise kernels; do not assume measurable target selection or desired recovery.
